properties.label: Offer table
properties.tooltip: Bind a table with eyebrow, headline, price, priceNote, validUntil and smallPrint columns. Two spaces in the headline start a new line, so the copy controls its own break.

properties.label: Seconds per offer
properties.tooltip: How long each offer holds before the next one. Ignored when only one offer is bound.

properties.label: Empty message
properties.default: No offer is scheduled right now.

properties.label: Surround colour
properties.tooltip: Fills the screen edge left over when the surface is not 16:9. It is not part of the poster, so matching it to the room usually reads better than matching it to the artwork.
